purpose: Test whether five materially different Persistent Changes actually improve a later loop, rather than inferring recursive improvement from persistence, capability, behavior change, deterministic preprocessing, or local craft priors alone.
claimBoundary: This round does not establish open-ended RSI, autonomous problem selection, a universal improvement score, or a PAL controller. P1-P5 were deliberately selected by the current research process; L5 autonomous pressure selection remains unproven.

observations.ownerReconstructable: fresh-owner baseline 12/12 correct; checkpoint-assisted 12/12 correct; checkpoint added about 9k prompt tokens and no correctness gain
observations.irreducibleTaskPrivateState: fresh baseline 6/6 safely abstained rather than guessed; checkpoint treatment 6/6 made exact productive progress from participant commitments or unresolved identity

results.law: stored state != useful persistence; persistence value concentrates in irreducible task-private semantic commitments and exact unresolved identity
results.disposition: Retain Host semantic continuity boundary. Do not broaden it into generic Memory or preserve owner-reconstructable context merely because storage is cheap.

observations.worldOpenAlex: all paths 3/3; median latency ambient 3611ms, native-a 1742ms, native-b 1599ms
observations.deepseekReachability: all paths 3/3; median latency ambient 2071ms, native-a 504ms, native-b 496ms
observations.maintenance: two dedicated scoped services plus current digest-bound admission and destination qualification

results.law: available capability != expanded useful work; option value and performance value are real but distinct from current L4 transfer
results.disposition: Retain scoped paths as qualified option/failure-domain capability. Re-audit if no real workload ever consumes them when ambient is insufficient.

observations.ownerVerification: all runs verified, zero hidden references
observations.oscillation: treatment 25 aggregate movement oscillations versus baseline 9
observations.counterexample: after binding civilian custody, the treatment can still select a non-extraction responsibility:advance move

results.law: behavior change != held-out objective transfer; model-visible prior != model-realized future
results.disposition: Keep the prompt wording only as a Game-local product hypothesis. Do not promote it as shared RSI prior or force it with a planner.

observations.residual: in both h2 replicas the deterministic projection carried sourceBMatches=2 but the model reported 6

results.disposition: Retain exact externalized deterministic computation as useful equipment pressure. Do not promote Trust/Reputation, a generic EvidenceReducer service, or reliable L4 from a campaign that failed its 12/12 gate.

observations.baselineResidual: About desktop first viewport exposed the thesis heading but not the introductory explanatory paragraph while source/type/build/mechanical gates were green
observations.treatment: desktop About hero only; no content, fact or component change
observations.localization: About desktop pixels changed; About mobile and both Colophon controls remained byte-identical
observations.ownerGate: 228/228 Playwright plus build/type/lint/publication/design/accessibility passed on current Web main
observations.currentReview: new browser-runtime implementation reproduced the exact treatment/control pixel digests

results.law: rendered encounter evidence can improve later production mechanics without becoming human-response evidence
results.disposition: Retain the local CSS correction and render-review discipline. Human preference/comprehension remains UNKNOWN; no universal visual score or review service is justified.

crossProjectLaws: a Persistent Change earns recursive-improvement credit only from later independent consumption, not from immediate plausibility or technical correctness

requiredCoordinates: later independent consumption or held-out workload
owner-native outcome improvement relevant to the claimed mechanism
no hidden answer compilation or evaluator leakage
maintenance/fragility/cost accounted when the retained change has recurring cost

rsiModelUpdate.before: Persistent Change was treated as a strong proxy for recursive improvement once it clearly changed later state.
rsiModelUpdate.after: Persistent Change is only an L3 candidate. L4 requires later independent evidence that the change improves the improvement process or a later owner outcome within the claimed scope. P1-P4 show four distinct ways L3 can fail to become L4; P5 demonstrates one narrow successful transfer.
rsiModelUpdate.l5: Autonomous pressure/problem selection remains unproven. This round was selected by explicit research judgment and supplies no evidence that C6 should be reversed.

architectureDisposition.reason: WML v2 and current owner-native evidence already express every P1-P5 result. The round changes research admission standards, not the runtime architecture.

nextReopenConditions: P1: a natural cross-session task shows that one retained semantic commitment improves a later improvement outcome beyond safe continuation alone
P2: a real ambient failure or new workload makes a retained scoped path uniquely enable useful downstream work; do not synthesize failure merely to promote the capability
P3: a materially different held-out world/model or predeclared full-horizon campaign demonstrates objective transfer without planner answer compilation
P4: a consumer uses deterministic evidence without reintroducing transcription/interpretation error, or a second domain independently demands the same exact-computation boundary
P5: another ordinary Web/Studio production independently consumes render-review and changes a bounded production outcome; human-response claims still require human evidence
L5: only a materially different owner-generated pressure signal/representation may reopen autonomous problem selection; do not rerun C6 with cosmetic prompt changes
